contexts.text: The throne () = Heaven.

The heavens are My throne (). The heavens = celestial and spiritual things... thus all things which are of internal worship, and of the internal sense: these are... called the Lord's throne. AC 2162:9.
The promise to the disciples that they should sit on twelve thrones. Explained. AC 8705:2. AE 431:6, Explained.
Then shall He sit upon the throne of His glory () = Judgment; for throne is predicated of the Lord's royalty, (which) is Divine truth; and from and according to this is Judgment. AC 5313:3.
The throne of David () = the Heaven of the Lord. AC 5313:4. AC 10360:6.
Seat, or throne, in the opposite sense, = the kingdom of what is false. Illustrated.
Thrones () = the truths of intelligence from the good of wisdom.
Throne = Heaven; properly, the Divine truth proceeding from the Lord which forms Heaven. Illustrated.
They want to climb into the throne of God.
Pharaoh's firstborn who sits upon his throne () = the falsified truths of faith which are in the first place. Explained... Throne = the kingdom of truth; in the opposite, the kingdom of falsity.
The thrones cast down () = falsities. His throne = Heaven and the Church. AE 336:9.

His hand is against the throne of Jah () = that they want to inflict violence on the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom... The reason the throne of Jah = the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom, is that throne is predicated of the Lord's royalty, (which) corresponds to His Spiritual Kingdom.
As Heaven is the Lord as to Divine truth, it is said, Thou shalt not swear by Heaven, because it is God's throne (); for the throne of God = the Divine truth which proceeds from the Lord. AC 9714:2.
The throne upon which was the appearance of a Man () = the Divine truth from the Lord's Divine good. (The throne = Heaven; and the Man upon it = the Lord Himself. AE 595:4.)
Hence Heaven is called the throne of God, because by... a throne is signified truth Divine from the Lord as received in the Middle Heaven. HH 8:end. HH 24.
To sit upon the throne of glory () = to judge from the Divine truth which is from Him.
Plenary vastation, is signified by the thrones being cast down ().
By the throne upon which the Lord was seen, is signified Heaven.

This is the place of My throne... (). Here the temple with its court is called the place of the throne of Jehovah... because the temple with its court represented Heaven. The throne of Jehovah = the Spiritual Heaven.
He shall sit upon the throne in Truth () = the Divine truth proceeding from the Lord, and thence the Spiritual Kingdom.
I saw the Lord sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up () = Heaven; in special, the Spiritual Heaven. ( = the Lord as to Divine truth in the higher Heavens. AE 220:5.) AE 285:2.
The seven Spirits who are before His throne () = from the universal Heaven, where the Lord is in His Divine truth...
That the throne of the Lord = Heaven. Illustrated.
I will give to sit with Me in My throne () = in Heaven; in special, where His Divine truth reigns. AR 221. AE 253, Explained.
Where Satan's throne is () = their life in thick darkness. ( = where all falsities reign. AE 134.)
Even as I sit with My Father in His throne () = as He and the Father are one, and are Heaven. ( = comparatively as the Divine [good] is united to the Divine truth in Heaven, AE 254.)
Lo a throne set () = Judgment in a representative form. And upon the throne One sitting = the Lord. ( = the Lord in respect to the Last Judgment. AE 267.)
That a throne = Judgment also. Illustrated. AR 233.

In the midst of the throne, and round about the throne, four animals () = the Lord's Word from primes in ultimates, and its guards. Explained. ( = the Lord's Providence and guard that the interior Heavens be not approached except by the good of love and of charity, in order that the lower things, which depend thereon, may be in order. AE 277.)
In the midst of the throne () = from the inmosts and thence in all things of Heaven. ( = in the whole Heaven. AE 313.)
The voice of the Angels around the throne () = the confession and Glorification of the Lord by the Angels of the lower Heavens. AE 335.
Therefore they are before the throne of God () = that they are in the Lord's presence. ( = that hence they are conjoined with the Lord. AE 477.)
The Lamb who is in the midst of the throne () = the Lord as to His Divine Human in the Inmost Heaven and thus in all things of Heaven. ( = the Lord in the whole Heaven. AE 482.)
He was caught up to God and His throne () = the protection of the Doctrine... by the Lord, and its guardianship by the Angels of Heaven... The throne = the angelic Heaven. AE 728.
The dragon gave him his throne () = that this heresy prevails through its reception by the laity. ( = that they strengthen their doctrinals by reasonings from falsities. AE 783.)
Throne = government.
They sang as it were a new song before the throne () = the celebration... of the Lord before Him. AE 858.

They are without spot before the throne of God () = that they are in truths from good from the Lord. The throne of God = the Lord and Heaven. ( = that in the sight of the Angels they are without falsities from evil. AE 867.)

Poured his vial upon the throne of the beast () = influx into their faith... Throne = kingdom... That throne is said of the government of evil and falsity. Illustrated. ( = the state of the Church manifested as to the doctrine of faith. AE 988.)
Throne = Heaven, and also Judgment.
Throne = Heaven and the Kingdom there, and also Judgment.

I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and Judgment was given unto them () = that the truths of the Word, according to which all are judged, were opened... ( = that Judgment belongs to the Lord alone. AE 270:2.)
I saw a throne white and great, and He that sat upon it () = the universal Judgment effected by the Lord... from Divine truths and Divine good. AR 865:2.
That the throne = Judgment in a representative form. References.
Going out of the throne of God and of the Lamb () = out of Heaven from the Lord; for the throne = the Lord as to Judgment, and as to government, and as to Heaven.
The throne of God and of the Lamb shall be in it () = that the Lord Himself will reign in the New Church; for the throne, here, = the Kingdom; and the Lord's Kingdom is where He alone is worshipped.
Before His throne () = presence and providence... The throne of God = the Divine truth proceeding from the Lord; thus Heaven, which is the receptacle.
It was therefore a custom for a king... to sit upon a throne of silver...
Thrones, in the Word, = Judgment from Divine truths; and, in the supreme sense, the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom, where the Divine truth is received more than the Divine good. AE 205:4.
To come and set everyone his throne at the door of the gates of Jerusalem () = to destroy by falsities the truths which introduce into the Church.

Throne, in the Word, when predicated of the Lord, = in general, Heaven; in special, the Spiritual Heaven; and, abstractedly, the Divine truth proceeding from the Lord, because this makes Heaven. Hence, also, throne is predicated of Judgment, because all Judgment is effected from truths. Illustrated. AE 289. AE 687:4.
Therefore, in the opposite sense, throne = Hell as to all falsity. Illustrated.
A throne, in the midst of Heaven, () = Judgment.
Throne, therefore, here = all things of Heaven and the Church.
As throne = Heaven, and as He who sat upon the throne = the Lord as to His Divine in Heaven, it is said, To him that overcometh I will grant to sit with Me in My throne.
The throne of God and the Lamb = Heaven and the Lord there as to Divine good and as to Divine truth. AE 460. AE 460:3.

His throne as the sun before Me () = the Lord's Heaven and Church which are in celestial good: the throne steadfast as the moon to eternity = the Heaven and Church which are in spiritual good, which is Divine truth. AE 594:9.

Solomon made a throne of ivory with six steps, and twelve lions standing upon the steps (). Solomon's throne = Judgment, which is effected by truths from good, and it represented Divine truth from Divine good; the twelve lions = all the truths of Heaven and the Church in their power.
The throne of the house of Israel () = the Church where Divine truth reigns.
Throne, when predicated of the Lord, = Heaven and the Church (which are the Lord's Kingdom).
To stand around the throne () = conjunction with the Lord. Explained.
Before the throne () = conjunction with Heaven.
Throne () = Heaven and the Church.

To sit upon thrones () = to be in the work of judging; for thrones = the Heavens; and to sit upon thrones = to judge; and as the Angels do not judge, but the Lord alone... these words = that the higher Heavens are in light and power from the Lord to separate the evil from the good...

All the princes of the sea shall come down from their thrones () = that the Knowledges of truth will reign no more with the men of that Church; for all the kingdom belongs to the Divine truth. To descend from the thrones = from the government. To sit upon thrones = to be in the truths of Heaven.
The throne which he shall have () = Heaven.
Throne () = Heaven and the Church as to the reception of Divine truth.
The throne of David () = the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom.

The reason the doctrine of faith is meant by the throne of the beast, is that throne, in the supreme sense, = Heaven and the Church as to Divine truth; and Divine truth in the Christian Church is called faith.
Throne () = where the Lord is as to Judgment.
Therefore the Heaven, where Divine truth reigns, is called His throne.

They adored God who sitteth upon the throne () = the adoration of the Lord, who has all power in the Heavens and on earth... The throne, where predicated of the Lord, = the universal Heaven, and also all power there; and power on earth cannot be separated.
A voice came out of the throne () = the unanimity of the universal Heaven; for the throne = the whole Heaven, from the fact that the Lord is upon it; and the Lord is Heaven itself.
